portal_hypertension.title: Soluble endoglin as a marker of clinically significant portal hypertension in patients with cirrhosis.
portal_hypertension.authors: Igreja Sa IC, Smid V, Fikrova P
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 60）。核心观点：门静脉高压（​​PH）是肝硬化的主要并发症之一，传统上使用肝静脉压力梯度（HVPG）等侵入性方法进行评估。 临床提示：可溶性内皮糖蛋白（sENG）是内皮功能障碍和纤维化的标志物，已被提议作为各种肝脏疾病的非侵入性生物标志物。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Portal hypertension (PH) is one of the major complications of liver cirrhosis, traditionally assessed using invasive methods such as the hepatic venous pressure gradient (HVPG). Soluble endoglin (sENG), a marker of endothelial dysfunction and fibrosis, has been proposed as a non-invasive biomarker of various liver diseases. This study aimed to evaluate serum sENG concentrations in cirrhotic patients with PH and investigate its relationship with PH severity, alcohol consumption, and smoking.
